newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - May 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Busang gold discovery in Indonesia touted by Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd as the richest find of the century was falsified on a scale "without precedent in the history of mining," according to a report released on Sunday.
- President Ramos leaves tomorrow for a ten-day trip to the United States, Mexico and Panama, his 26th trip since he became the President.

- The opposition in the House of Representatives yesterday vowed to undertake a line-by-line scrutiny of the government's biggest appropriation request in history to ensure it will not be used for re-election. The government proposed a 540 billion-peso budget for 1998.
